newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat rallies late on short covering.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat rallies late on short covering.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures bounced off their lows and crossed into positive territory late in a short-covering rally, traders said.

"This is a very impressive day -- a day that is encouraging additional short covering because we've been able to shake off bearish news and trade higher. Technically it's a very strong performance," a KCBT trader said.
KCBT wheat had opened lower after USDA raised sharply its estimate of U.S. winter wheat production, traders said.
At 1303 CDT, KCBT wheat was 1/2 to 3-3/4 cent higher, with September up 2-3/4 cents at $3.37.
KCBT Sept wheat fell to $3.28 early after USDA pegged U.S. winter wheat production at 1.781 billion bushels, topping analysts' average projection of 1.687 billion.
USDA also estimated U.S. HRW wheat output at 1.062 billion bushels, exceeding the average analysts' expectation of 1.000 billion bushels.
